inputs.description: Token for the admin page at /admin, where you invite users. Generated at installation.
inputs.name: adminToken

zh-CN.summary: 兼容 Bitwarden 的密码管理器，不开放注册，由管理员邀请用户。

zh-TW.summary: 相容 Bitwarden 的密碼管理器，不開放註冊，由管理員邀請使用者。

metadata.name: Vaultwarden
metadata.summary: A Bitwarden-compatible password manager; sign-up is closed and the admin invites people.

zh-CN.summary: Vaultwarden 以普通用户（UID 1000）运行，根文件系统只读，没有服务账号令牌，也没有额外的 Linux 权限。向外的网络流量没有限制。注册功能是关闭的。

zh-TW.summary: Vaultwarden 以一般使用者（UID 1000）執行，根檔案系統唯讀，沒有服務帳號權杖，也沒有額外的 Linux 權限。往外的網路流量沒有限制。註冊功能是關閉的。

zh-CN.mitigation: SIGNUPS_ALLOWED 设为 false。用 vaultwarden-secrets 里的令牌登录 /admin，再用邮箱邀请用户。没有配置 SMTP 时，受邀的邮箱可以直接注册。
zh-CN.risk: 任何连得到服务器的人都可能创建账号。

zh-TW.mitigation: SIGNUPS_ALLOWED 設為 false。用 vaultwarden-secrets 裡的權杖登入 /admin，再用 Email 邀請使用者。沒有設定 SMTP 時，受邀的 Email 可以直接註冊。
zh-TW.risk: 任何連得到伺服器的人都可能建立帳號。

risks.mitigation: SIGNUPS_ALLOWED is false. Sign in to /admin with the token in vaultwarden-secrets, and invite users by email. Without SMTP, an invited address can register directly.
risks.risk: Anyone who can reach the server could create an account.

zh-CN.mitigation: 限制谁能读取这个机密。想改用哈希值，就在终端执行 vaultwarden hash，再把生成的 PHC 字符串存进机密。
zh-CN.risk: 管理员令牌以纯文本放在机密里。Vaultwarden 会在日志里提醒你改用 Argon2 哈希值。

zh-TW.mitigation: 限制誰能讀取這個機密。想改用雜湊值，就在終端機執行 vaultwarden hash，再把產生的 PHC 字串存進機密。
zh-TW.risk: 管理員權杖以純文字放在機密裡。Vaultwarden 會在日誌裡提醒你改用 Argon2 雜湊值。

risks.mitigation: Limit who can read the Secret. To use a hash, run vaultwarden hash in a terminal and store the resulting PHC string in the Secret.
risks.risk: The admin token is stored as plain text in a Secret. Vaultwarden logs a notice that recommends an Argon2 hash instead.

zh-CN.mitigation: 进去需要 43 个字符的管理员令牌。邀请完用户之后，删掉 ADMIN_TOKEN 变量，就能把这个页面关掉。
zh-CN.risk: 管理页面通过 Ingress 对外公开。

zh-TW.mitigation: 進去需要 43 個字元的管理員權杖。邀請完使用者之後，刪掉 ADMIN_TOKEN 變數，就能把這個頁面關掉。
zh-TW.risk: 管理頁面透過 Ingress 對外公開。

risks.mitigation: It needs the 43-character admin token. To remove the page, delete the ADMIN_TOKEN variable after you have invited your users.
risks.risk: The admin page is public through the Ingress.

zh-CN.mitigation: 设置 SMTP_ 开头的变量。
zh-CN.risk: 没有配置 SMTP 服务器，所以邀请邮件、两步验证邮件和紧急访问邮件都发不出去。

zh-TW.mitigation: 設定 SMTP_ 開頭的變數。
zh-TW.risk: 沒有設定 SMTP 伺服器，所以邀請信、兩步驟驗證信和緊急存取信都寄不出去。

risks.risk: No SMTP server is set up, so invitation emails, two-factor emails and emergency access emails are not sent.

zh-CN.mitigation: Vaultwarden 默认会拒绝非公网（内网）的地址。想关掉图标服务，就设置 ICON_SERVICE=none。
zh-CN.risk: 图标服务会从用户保存的网站下载网站图标。

zh-TW.mitigation: Vaultwarden 預設會拒絕非公開網路（內網）的位址。想關掉圖示服務，就設定 ICON_SERVICE=none。
zh-TW.risk: 圖示服務會從使用者儲存的網站下載網站圖示。

risks.mitigation: Vaultwarden refuses non-global (private) addresses by default. Set ICON_SERVICE=none to turn the icon service off.
risks.risk: The icon service downloads favicons from the websites your users save.

security.summary: Vaultwarden runs as an unprivileged user (UID 1000) with a read-only root filesystem, no service-account token and no extra Linux capabilities. Outbound traffic is not limited. Sign-up is closed.

manifests:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: vaultwarden-data
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 10Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: vaultwarden
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  serviceName: vaultwarden
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: vaultwarden
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        templates.zeabur.com/template: vaultwarden
        app.kubernetes.io/name: vaultwarden
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        fsGroupChangePolicy: OnRootMismatch
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
      - name: vaultwarden
        image: vaultwarden/server:1.37.5@sha256:4fe17f415f90087377d37c755e0ea3cf189dcc6794e49cdd2a9adbb4937d9e1f
        ports:
        - name: http
          containerPort: 8080
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop: [ALL]
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 50m
            memory: 64Mi
          limits:
            cpu: '1'
            memory: 512Mi
        env:
        - name: ROCKET_PORT
          value: '8080'
        - name: DOMAIN
          value: https://{{ .Domain }}
        - name: DATA_FOLDER
          value: /data
        - name: SIGNUPS_ALLOWED
          value: 'false'
        - name: INVITATIONS_ALLOWED
          value: 'true'
        - name: SHOW_PASSWORD_HINT
          value: 'false'
        - name: IP_HEADER
          value: X-Forwarded-For
        - name: ADMIN_TOKEN
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: vaultwarden-secrets
              key: admin-token
        volumeMounts:
        - name: data
          mountPath: /data
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
        startupProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /alive
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 60
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /alive
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 10
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /alive
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 6
      volumes:
      - name: data
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: vaultwarden-data
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 256Mi
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: vaultwarden
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: vaultwarden
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 8080
    targetPort: http
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: vaultwarden
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: '{{ .ClusterIssuer }}'
spec:
  ingressClassName: traefik
  tls:
  - hosts: ['{{ .Domain }}']
    secretName: vaultwarden-tls
  rules:
  - host: '{{ .Domain }}'
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: vaultwarden
            port:
              number: 8080
